description: Agent development on PenguinHarness: build on the SDK, call any model through one unified LLM API, manage models and secrets, orchestrate agents, sessions, costs and schedules, and set up a company-mode organization together with the user.
description_zh: 基于 PenguinHarness 的智能体开发：用 SDK 构建应用、经统一的 LLM API 调用任意模型、管理模型与密钥、编排智能体/会话/成本/定时任务，并与用户一起创建公司模式的组织。
short_description: SDK, unified LLM API, config, orchestration and company setup.
short_description_zh: SDK、统一 LLM API、配置、编排与公司创建。
